sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I ran an inventory check recently. Not myself, I had my guys handle it. Turns out we still need to clear out a couple more crates. You know the drill: take the gun, make it look good on the battlefield, and I'll handle the sales. You get your percentage, same as always."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 40 enemies with headshots while using a Velociraptor, PKP or SR-2M

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +8,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.02
- 90,000 Roubles
- 32 GP coins
